Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from the entertaining game. India Women have started this series with a win but there is no shortage of games. The action continues on Saturday 21st January as South Africa Women take on West Indies Women at this very venue and the match starts at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Amanjot Kaur gets the Player of the Match award on her debut for scoring 41 runs in 30 balls. She says that she is really happy to contribute to the team as she got her opportunity and was able to grab it. Claims that she was thinking about getting as many runs as possible and was hoping that it would help her team to win. Mentions that Deepti Sharma helped her calm her nerves because she was nervous since it was her debut.

Smriti Mandhana the captain of India Women says that she is proud that her team showed character by building a match-winning partnership and the spinners did well on this wicket. Mentions that with the start they had, they were aiming for 120 but the kind of batting done by Amanjot Kaur and Deepti Sharma got them 15 runs more, so credit to them. Claims that they asked the batters how the wicket was playing and they said that it was turning and was very dry which suits their spin bowlers. Adds that they bowled well while planning among themselves and whatever they decided, they executed well.

Sune Luus the skipper of South Africa Women says that it was their first game in 7 months. Adds that there is still a long way to go in this series and they will look to come back stronger. Mentions that they started off well but gave away way too many runs at the end. Lauds Deepti Sharma for her performance.  Claims that she felt like she was playing India Women in India with the amount of turn the pitch had to offer. Reckons that they needed someone to stay longer out in the middle and they could have chased down the target.
Time for the presentations...

The hosts had a great opportunity to win this game in the first inning as they had India Women struggling at 69 for the loss of 5 wickets. Yastika Bhatia was the only batter in the top five to get to double figures as she put on 35 runs. However, Amanjot Kaur and Deepti Sharma put together a 76-run partnership in 50 balls to take their team to a comfortable position. India Women did not let go of the advantage thereafter as the bowlers tightened the screws and sealed a massive win.

South Africa Women could not get going as they were put under pressure straight away when they lost Laura Wolvaardt early. Anne Bosch followed her opening partner back to the shed soon after but Marizanne Kapp got together with Sune Luus and began rebuilding the inning but both departed after getting off to decent starts. Delmi Tucker departed on a golden duck and Chloe Tryon counterattack did not last long. Nadine de Klerk and Sinalo Jafta tried to get things moving but they were well behind the eight ball by then. Eventually, they crumbled towards the end and fell well short of the target.

India Women complete a comprehensive win! With the way the game started for them, no one would have guessed that they would win this tie by 27 runs. They grew in strength as the game progressed and they were all over their opponents. Their bowling proved to be a bit too strong for the South Africa Women batters as they were bundled out for 120 runs. Deepti Sharma got the early breakthrough as the spinners dominated proceedings from the word go. Eight wickets fell to the spinners with Deepti Sharma taking the last two and ending with three wickets in her kitty. Devika Vaidya got two crucial wickets with Sneh Rana, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, and Radha Yadav chipping in with one each.

OUT! STUMPED!! All-over for South Africa Women. India's Women get an easy win at the end by 27 runs. Deepti Sharma bowls this slow and outside off, Masabata Klaas got tempted into the shot and fails to get bat on the ball. She is Stumped here as Yastika Bhatia takes off the bails in a flash and Masabata Klaas is out for 2. Deepti Sharma picks up her third and caps off with a wonderful all-round effort.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it outside off, Ayabonga Khaka sweeps it from outside to deep mid-wicket for one.
Ayabonga Khaka makes her way out.

OUT! GONE! Tossed again on off, Sinalo Jafta advances, takes it on the full, and hits it off the toe end back to Deepti Sharma who takes a good low catch. There was no celebration on this one as nonchalantly takes it with ease. Deepti Sharma takes her second as Sinalo Jafta walks back for 11.
Full and outside off, Sinalo Jafta sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR!! SMEARED! Overpitched outside off, Sinalo Jafta uses her feet again and pierces it through covers for a boundary. Excellent use of the feet and played nicely.
Tossed up outside off, Sinalo Jafta uses her feet and gets an outside edge as the ball runs away past short third for a couple.
Arm ball from Sneh Rana. Goes quicker and flatter past the batter. Masabata Klaas gets late to connect. A dot ball here.
Fuller outside off, Masabata Klaas uses her feet and drills it down to mid-off. A fumble from Smriti Mandhana allows the batter to take two.
WIDE! Fires this one full and angling down leg. Masabata Klaas misses her flick and the umpire indicates wide.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole. Masabata Klaas digs this out back towards the bowler.
Floats this one full and outside off. Masabata Klaas shoulders her arms to this one.
Masabata Klaas makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! GONE! PLAYED ON! Flatter going down the leg, Nadine de Klerk goes across again and plays on back onto her stumps. Another one down for South Africa Women as Sneh Rana takes her first one of the evening.
Full on the stumps. Sinalo Jafta looks to slog and gets an inside edge to the off side as they scamper for a quick single.
Quicker delivery, short of length on the leg stump, Nadine de Klerk goes for the pull but plays all over it.
Shuffles again and misses again. The ball ricochet off her pads to short third for none.
Length ball outside off, Nadine de Klerk gets down on a knee and forces this in the leg side wide of long on for a couple.
Length around off, Nadine de Klerk shuffles across to pull and misses it.
Slower and turning away outside off, Nadine de Klerk cuts it to covers.
Full on the leg peg, Sinalo Jafta sweeps it to deep mid-wicket.
This is full and outside the off stump Sinalo Jafta micues her slog towards deep mid-wicket for a single and will keep strike.
This is bowled slightly short and coming into the stumps. Sinalo Jafta rocks back and dabs this into the offside.
Sinalo Jafta is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! GONE! LBW! Radha Yadav darts this one in on the stumps with the angle, pitches on the middle stump, and gets a little amount of turn away from the batter. Chloe Tryon goes for the sweep across the line and is hit on the back leg. Big appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in giving it out. South Africa Women lose their seventh wicket now with 45 runs still required.
Full outside off, Nadine de Klerk dances down the track and drives straight to mid-off for a quick single.
Good length outside off, punched off the backfoot to the backward point by Nadine de Klerk.
FOUR!! Length ball on the off stump, Nadine de Klerk dances down the track and lofts between deep extra and long off for four.
FOUR!! BONUS! Fuller one on the stumps, Chloe Tryon uses her feet and hits it to the long-on region. The fielder took her eyes off the ball as the ball goes past her for a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk sweeps hard to mid-wicket for one.
Full again on the pads, Chloe Tryon tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full on the leg peg, Chloe Tryon works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! SHOT!! Fuller on the stumps, Chloe Tryon uses her feet, makes room, and hits it through covers for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Full and on the leg peg, Chloe Tryon misses out on the slog sweep.
Loopy delivery full and outside off. Chloe Tryon punches this towards cover and takes a single.

Goes full and into the stumps. Chloe Tryon looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Massive appeal but the umpire says not out. Might have been an inside edge because this looked quite close.
Flights this one full and outside off. Nadine de Klerk looks to sweep but gets it off the toes end towards short third man for a run.
Fires this one full and into the stumps. Nadine de Klerk digs this out towards mid off.
Floats this one full and outside off. Chloe Tryon knocks this to extra cover for a run.
Radha Yadav flights this one full and outside off. Chloe Tryon dabs this towards backward point.
Goes full once again and into the pads. Chloe Tryon eases this down to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Chloe Tryon knocks this back toward sthe bowler.
FOUR! Chloe Tryon looking to provide a fightback here! Devika Vaidya bowls this full and outside off. Chloe Tryon sweeps this hard towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Continues to bowl short and outside off. Nadine de Klerk slaps this straight to cover and a misfield allows them to take a single.
Short once again and outside off. Gets stuck in the wicket and takes time to reach the batter. Chloe Tryon mistimes this towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! That has been whipped away! Devika Vaidya bowls this slightly short and outside off. Chloe Tryon is onto it in a flash as she pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Continues to bowl full and outside off. Nadine de Klerk dabs this back down the pitch back towards the bowler.
This is full as well and outside the off pole. Nadine de Klerk knocks this straight to backward point.

Edged and just short! Anjali Sarvani goes full once again and serves this outside off. Nadine de Klerk looks to drive and gets an outside edge that falls short of the keeper and bounces past her for a couple of runs.
FOUR!! Full and outside off, Nadine de Klerk leans into it and drives it nicely through the covers past the fielder for a beautiful boundary. Excellent shot by Nadine de Klerk
Full and outside off, Chloe Tryon drives it to deep point for one.
Full and a tad outside off, Chloe Tryon misses out on the drive.
Anjali Sarvani starts off with a Wide ball outside the tramline. Left alone by Chloe Tryon.
Tosses it up on the stumps, Nadine de Klerk gets on the front foot and defends back to the bowler.

OUT! TIMBER! Deceived in the flight! Devika Vaidya loops this one full and in line with the stumps. Delmi Tucker plays down at the wrong line and the ball beats her outside edge to shatter the stumps. South Africa Women are collapsing here and India Women have a firm grip on this game. South Africa Women need to get a partnership going here as they find half their side back in the shed. Nadine de Klerk is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! RUN OUT! A big blow for South Africa Women as they lose their skipper due to a massive miscommunication! Devika Vaidya floats this one full and just outside off. Chloe Tryon dabs this towards mid on and looks for a quick single. Sune Luus is ball-watching and responds late for the run. Rajeshwari Gayakwad collects the ball and throws it to the keeper. Yastika Bhatia whips the bails off and South Africa Women lose their fourth wicket. Delmi Tucker makes her way out to the middle.
Slightly short and coming into the stumps. Sune Luus tucks this to the right on mid on and takes one.
This is full as well and outside off, Sune Luus sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Devika Vaidya floats this one full and outside off. Chloe Tryon drives it to long off for a single.

DRINKS! The players will take a short break. The Indian spinners have made the run-scoring difficult for the South Africa Women.  They need to score at nearly 10 runs per over on this slow surface. Someone will have to bat out of their skin to take them over the line.
Bowls this one back of a length and just outside off. Sune Luus pulls this to deep mid-wicket for another brace.
This is short and wide outside off, just inside the tram line. Sune Luus leaves this one alone.
Continues bowling short and outside off. Sune Luus works this to the left of cover and takes one.
This is slightly short and outside off. Sune Luus cuts this towards deep point and picks up a couple of runs.
Bowls this on a good length and outside off. Chloe Tryon punches this to deep cover for a single.
Amanjot Kaur bowls this on a good length and outside off. Sune Luus dabs this towards point for a single.
Chloe Tryon makes her way out to the middle. Amanjot Kaur comes into the attack.

OUT! GONE!! CAUGHT! Huge wicket for India Women as Marizanne Kapp departs! Full and turned away after pitching. Marizanne Kapp uses her feet and mistimes the hit straight into the hands of Sneh Rana at long-off who takes it with ease. India tightens their grip on this game as South Africa Women lose their 3rd and Marizanne Kapp departs for 22. 94 needed off the final 10 overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Devika Vaidya

Full and quicker on the stumps. Sune Luus punches it back to the bowler.

India Women chipping into this batting order nicely.
